name: Distance to Superquadrics
definition: Generalization of distance metrics using the $L_p$ norm. Natural quadrics become superquadrics, and tori become supertori. A unifying metric space must be used, requiring conversion of $L_p$-norm distances into Euclidean distances.
summary: Distance to Superquadrics generalizes natural quadrics using Lp norms to create shapes with adjustable squareness or pinchedness, requiring Euclidean conversion for consistent ray marching.
